			check_variable = { dd_intel_mission = 6 }
			has_country_flag = dd_intel_locked
			var:dd_intel_mission_target = { has_tech = jet_engines }
			NOT = { has_tech = jet_engines }
		}
		cost = 0
		ai_will_do = { factor = 0 }
		complete_effect = {
			clr_country_flag = dd_intel_steal_ok
			if = {
				limit = { dd_intel_is_t1 = yes }
				set_technology = { jet_engines = 1 }
				set_country_flag = dd_intel_steal_ok
			}
			else = {
				dd_intel_det_flip = yes
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { dd_intel_flip = 0 } }
					set_technology = { jet_engines = 1 }
					set_country_flag = dd_intel_steal_ok
				}
			}
			var:dd_intel_mission_target = {
				if = {
					limit = { ROOT = { has_country_flag = dd_intel_steal_ok } }
					news_event = { id = doomsday_intel.12 hours = 2 }
				}
				else = {
					news_event = { id = doomsday_intel.13 hours = 2 }
				}
			}
			clr_country_flag = dd_intel_steal_ok
			dd_intel_finish_locked = yes
		}
	}

}
